name: Recycling Symbol
instruction: Design a 3D model of the universal recycling symbol. The arrows should form a continuous loop, pointing clockwise.

Shape accuracy: The object is a universal recycling symbol.
The symbol consists of three arrows.
The arrows are arranged in a continuous loop.
Color representation: The symbol is typically represented in green.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The arrows are proportionate to the symbol.
Texture and surface detail: The surface of the arrows is smooth.
There may be a slight sheen to represent a recyclable material.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The arrows are positioned to create a clear loop.
The arrows maintain a consistent distance from each other.
Object distance and contact: The arrows do not overlap inappropriately.
The ends of the arrows connect seamlessly.

Instruction execution accuracy: The design accurately reflects the universal recycling symbol.
The arrows are correctly oriented and form a loop.
